nodes.summary: Excellency, there are {%STRING1} ready to join our colony on the docks
nodes.trigger: Tutorial Hints on: colonists are waiting on the docks in the home Europe port ready to join a colony, prompting the player to send a ship.
nodes.inputs: Europe-port immigrant queue (which specialists are on the docks), the home port name; shown-bit.
nodes.outputs: Hint box noting colonists are ready on the docks in Europe and a ship sent there will bring them to the New World.

nodes.label: TUTORIAL6
nodes.summary: Sire, there are {%NUMBER0} {%STRING0} in {%STRING1}.  If we move a ship
nodes.trigger: Tutorial Hints on: a colony has accumulated a sellable cargo, prompting the player to ship it to Europe for profit.
nodes.inputs: Colony stored-cargo amount and type, the colony name and the home Europe port name; shown-bit.
nodes.outputs: Hint box telling the player to move a ship into the colony, pick up the cargo, and sell it in Europe.

nodes.label: TUTORIAL7
nodes.summary: %STRING0 is growing rapidly, Your Excellency, and we may want to
nodes.trigger: Tutorial Hints on: a colony is growing rapidly and is unprotected, suggesting the player build a Stockade.
nodes.inputs: Colony name and growth/size; shown-bit.
nodes.outputs: Hint box explaining the build chain (Lumberjack chops lumber, Carpenter makes buildings, then click the Hammer button to choose what to build) and to consider a Stockade.

nodes.label: TUTORIAL8
nodes.summary: This %STRING0 has no specialty profession.  If we move him into a
nodes.trigger: Tutorial Hints on: a colonist with no specialty profession stands near a friendly native village that could teach a skill.
nodes.inputs: Active unit type/profession (no specialty), terrain/feature under and around the unit (native village within range); shown-bit.
nodes.outputs: Hint box suggesting moving the unspecialized colonist into the friendly native village so the natives may teach him a skill.

nodes.label: TUTORIAL9
nodes.summary: This looks like a good place for a {road}.  Our {pioneers} will build
nodes.trigger: Tutorial Hints on: a pioneer is on a tile that is a good place for a road (resource terrain band).
nodes.inputs: Active pioneer position, neighbour terrain band scan; shown-bit.
nodes.outputs: Hint box explaining roads (press 'R'); roads boost fur/lumber/ore/silver here and speed unit movement.

nodes.label: CLEARCUT
nodes.summary: Pioneers clear forest near {%STRING0}.  {%NUMBER0 lumber} added
nodes.trigger: A Pioneer finishes clearing a forest tile that is adjacent to one of your colonies; the felled timber is added to that colony's lumber stockpile.
nodes.inputs: The cleared forest tile; nearest owning colony; lumber yield N from the clear. Handled in the clear-forest overlay func_040656.
nodes.outputs: Forest is removed and {N lumber} is added to the colony stockpile. Shows 'Pioneers clear forest near X. {N lumber} added to stockpile.'.

nodes.label: GRUDGEWAGONS
nodes.summary: "We grudgingly receive your wagons in spite of the
nodes.trigger: Your wagon train arrives to trade at a native settlement of a tribe that is angry at you (you have committed atrocities), but the tribe grudgingly trades anyway.
nodes.inputs: Tribe's attitude toward you / atrocity record; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C (wagon-train-at-settlement outcome, sibling of the haggle resolver).
nodes.outputs: Trade proceeds: 'We grudgingly receive your wagons in spite of the atrocities you have committed against the X people.'.

nodes.label: KILLWAGONS
nodes.summary: Your Excellency! Our {wagon train} has disappeared
nodes.trigger: Your wagon train enters the territory of a tribe hostile enough that it is destroyed/disappears (the worst wagon-at-settlement outcome).
nodes.inputs: Tribe attitude/hostility; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C.
nodes.outputs: The wagon train is lost. Shows 'Our wagon train has disappeared without a trace in X country.'.

nodes.label: LOBOTOMIZE
nodes.summary: Do you wish to {clear} this colonist's specialty
nodes.trigger: Player chooses to clear a colonist's specialty (the 'Clear Specialty' job), turning a specialist back into an ordinary Free Colonist.
nodes.inputs: Selected colonist's current specialty profession. Handled in func_028D8C.
nodes.outputs: Y/N confirmation: clear this colonist's specialty ({profession}) and make him an ordinary free colonist? On Yes, the unit's profession is reset to Free Colonist.

nodes.label: LOSTOURSCOUTS
nodes.summary: Our {scouts} near {%STRING1} have been captured by the {%STRING0}, Your
nodes.trigger: Your Scout attempts to infiltrate a foreign colony and fails, getting captured by the colony's owner.
nodes.inputs: Scout unit and the target colony's owning power; the infiltration outcome (data-resident odds). Resolved in the scout-action path func_059B90.
nodes.outputs: Your scout party is lost (captured). Shows 'Our scouts near X have been captured by the Y, Your Excellency!'.

nodes.label: LOSTTHEIRSCOUTS
nodes.summary: We have captured a party of {%STRING0 scouts} attempting
nodes.trigger: An enemy power's Scout attempts to infiltrate one of YOUR colonies and is caught.
nodes.inputs: Enemy scout; your colony; the scout's horse count N. Resolved in the scout-action path func_059B90.
nodes.outputs: You capture the enemy scout party and add its {N horses} to the colony stables. Shows 'We have captured a party of X scouts attempting to infiltrate Y... Their {N horses} have been taken to the colony stables.'.

nodes.label: MADATWAGONS
nodes.summary: "Because of the atrocities you have committed against
nodes.trigger: Your wagon train tries to trade at a native settlement of a tribe that, due to your atrocities, refuses to trade with you.
nodes.inputs: Tribe attitude/atrocity record; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C.
nodes.outputs: Trade refused: 'Because of the atrocities you have committed against the X people, we do not wish to trade with you.'.

nodes.label: MAYBEWITHDRAW
nodes.summary: "Our forces protect valid %STRING0 interests.  We are, however,
nodes.trigger: During a parley, when another power demands you withdraw forces near their colonies, this is the counter-offer where they agree to move THEIR forces in exchange for a demobilization payment. Surfaced in the diplomacy WITHDRAW negotiation block of func_057F4E.
nodes.inputs: The demobilization fee N (cost-to-move). Player's gold for the alternate 'pay' choice.
nodes.outputs: Dialog: 'Our forces protect valid interests. We are willing to move them in exchange for {N} to cover demobilization.' Options: pay N (gold transferred, forces withdraw), threaten ('withdraw or perish'), or never mind.

nodes.label: NEWCOLONIST
nodes.summary: Population increase in %STRING0.  New colonist now available.
nodes.trigger: A colony's accumulated food crosses the population-growth threshold during the colony turn update, producing a new colonist.
nodes.inputs: Colony food stockpile / growth counter. Emitted by the colony turn-update path func_02D658.
nodes.outputs: A new Free Colonist becomes available in the colony (placed on the 'fence'). Shows 'Population increase in X. New colonist now available.'.

nodes.label: NOMOREWAGONS
nodes.summary: {%STRING0} is set to produce a {Wagon Train}, Your
nodes.trigger: Player sets a colony to build a Wagon Train when the player already has as many wagon trains as colonies (the wagon-train cap = colony count).
nodes.inputs: Current wagon-train count vs colony count. Checked in the build-selection overlay func_02D0E4.
nodes.outputs: Refusal: 'X is set to produce a Wagon Train, but we are not allowed to have more wagon trains than we have colonies ({N}).'. Build order rejected.

nodes.label: NOPLOW
nodes.summary: That land has already been {plowed}.
nodes.trigger: Player orders a Pioneer to plow a tile that has already been plowed.
nodes.inputs: Target tile's plowed flag. Checked in the pioneer-order overlay func_02211E.
nodes.outputs: Refusal: 'That land has already been plowed.'. No action, no tools consumed.

nodes.label: NOROAD
nodes.summary: There is already a {road} here,
nodes.trigger: Player orders a Pioneer to build a road on a tile that already has a road.
nodes.inputs: Target tile's road flag. Checked in the pioneer-order overlay func_022334.
nodes.outputs: Refusal: 'There is already a road here, Your Excellency.'. No action, no tools consumed.

nodes.label: NOTWITHDRAW
nodes.summary: "Our forces protect valid %STRING0 interests and shall
nodes.trigger: During a parley, the other power flatly refuses to withdraw their forces near your colonies (the hard-no response to a withdraw request). Diplomacy WITHDRAW block of func_057F4E.
nodes.inputs: The other power's resolve (attitude/strength). Their forces remain in place.
nodes.outputs: 'Our forces protect valid X interests and shall not be moved.'. No withdrawal occurs.

nodes.label: UNITOPTIONS
nodes.summary: Move to front.
nodes.trigger: Player clicks a land unit in a colony to open its per-unit action menu.
nodes.inputs: Selected unit. Menu built in the unit-options overlay func_02B046.
nodes.outputs: Action menu listing: Move to front / Clear orders / Sentry-or-Board ship / Fortify / No changes (string handle for UNITOPTIONS). Choosing an item sets the unit's orders accordingly.

nodes.label: USEDUPTOOLS
nodes.summary: Our {pioneer} has reverted to {colonist} status after using
nodes.trigger: A Pioneer (or Hardy Pioneer) consumes the last of its tools while terraforming and reverts to a plain colonist.
nodes.inputs: Pioneer's remaining tool count reaching zero. Handled in the unit/terraform overlay func_040608.
nodes.outputs: The pioneer is converted back to Free Colonist (Hardy Pioneer keeps its expert class). Shows 'Our pioneer has reverted to colonist status after using all its tools.'.

nodes.label: VETERAN
nodes.summary: Our {%STRING0} have hardened to {Veteran} status,
nodes.trigger: A regular soldier/dragoon survives and 'hardens' into a Veteran after combat (the Veteran-promotion branch of the post-combat FX routine, reached on a combat WIN).
nodes.inputs: Winning UnitRecord whose post-combat reclassification hits the Veteran branch. Pre-veteran soldier/dragoon class.
nodes.outputs: The unit type advances to Veteran. Shows 'Our X have hardened to Veteran status, Your Excellency!'.
